nota_datos: Micronicho: casos OVNI cerrados. AARO GoFast Case Resolution: ene-2015, F/A-18F, FLIR, ~13.000 ft sobre el Atlántico frente a Florida; alta confianza de que no se movió a velocidad anómala; velocidad aparente por paralaje de movimiento; se movía con el viento (The Black Vault, iHeart/Kosloski ante el Congreso nov-2024). Ryan Graves (ex piloto de F/A-18) dijo que había más objetos y pidió seguir investigando (iHeart). Punto en pantalla = ilustración.
frases: This Navy video looks like a UFO racing over the ocean.
A fighter jet filmed it in 2015, off the coast of Florida.
For years, people called it the GoFast UFO.
Then the Pentagon's UFO office ran the math.
It wasn't near the water. It was about 13,000 feet up.
The jet was moving so fast, it made the object look fast. That trick is called parallax.
Their verdict: nothing unusual. It was moving with the wind.
Still, a former Navy pilot says there were more objects that day.
